label: Startup
info: Load device_configs & schedules vao global context khi Node-RED khoi dong

label: L1 MQTT Ingress
info: GENERIC parser: tele/+/SENSOR (ZbReceived) -> extract device theo short_addr, tra device_config de lay type. ALL devices route qua 1 link duy nhat sang L2 generic normalize.

label: L2 Device Abstraction
info: GENERIC normalize: doc device_config.extra.attrs de anh xa EF00/XXXX -> state. Bat ky device type nao cung di qua day, khong can sua code.

label: L3 Storage
info: Luu tru du lieu vao SQLite local: device_log (event + state change), device_config (metadata), schedule (lich).

label: L4 Schedule Engine
info: DATA-DRIVEN command builder. Doc device_config.extra de biet cach build ZbSend. Ho tro: POWER_ON, POWER_OFF, AC_SET, AC_OFF + custom_actions (mo rong tuy y).

label: L5 Dashboard
info: Dashboard UI: Device panel, Manual control, Log, Schedules, AC, Config

label: HMI Bridge
info: Nhan lenh ON/OFF tu LVGL cho AC (bms/ac/+/+/set) va Sign/MCB (bms/sign/+/power/set), phan hoi trang thai ve LVGL
